page.overview:
Who is Bosco Boffin?

Bosco was the eldest child and son of Buffo Boffin and Ivy Goodenough. He had three other siblings: Basso, Briffo, and Berylla. He married and had one son in TA 2812 (SR 1212), named Otto Boffin. He died in TA 2858 (SR 1258) at the age of ninety-one.
